apps.name: Qwen Image Editor
apps.tagline: Edit and create images with Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo on your own computer, in a simple editor or from Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and Goose.

downloads.needs: NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB+, driver 580 or newer, 32 GB RAM recommended, about 25 GB free disk
Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14 or newer

apps.note: The installers don't include the model. On first start the editor checks your computer, you accept Qwen's licence on Hugging Face, and the model downloads to your machine.

features.title: Point at what to change
features.text: Circle parts of an image in colours and describe each change. The circles are removed from the result.
features.prompt: Replace the earring in the red circle with a small silver stud, and remove the tattoo in the green circle. Keep everything else unchanged.

features.title: See what changed
features.text: Compare with a slider, side by side, or a Changes view that marks every edited pixel in red.

features.title: Transparent images
features.text: Make cut-outs and stickers with real transparency, or extract an object from a busy photo.
features.prompt: This is an RGBA image with transparency. Extract the latte cup and saucer from <image1> onto a transparent background. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

features.title: Inside your chat app
features.text: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and Goose can generate and edit, and open the editor in the chat so you can step in.

features.title: Loop mode
features.text: The agent makes an image, reviews it against a checklist, and fixes what fails, round after round until it passes.

examples.title: A 2D flyer from real photos
examples.text: Claude Desktop, four inputs: a barista, a latte, the shopfront and a style reference.

examples.title: A three-panel comic strip
examples.text: Claude Desktop, two character sheets and a café, the same characters in every panel.

examples.title: A hotel brochure
examples.text: Goose with a free OpenRouter model: three models, a hotel and two products in, three pages out.
